_comment: Feeds scanned by scripts/fetch-news.ts. Everything found lands in the
news_items queue as 'pending' and is invisible publicly until a human
approves it in /admin/news — so these are discovery aids, not sources of
truth. Broad queries are fine; the approval step is the guard.
Add any publisher's own RSS feed here too. 'label' is stored on each row as
discovered_via, so you can tell which query surfaced a story and prune the
KNOWN LIMITATION: Google News RSS returns news.google.com redirect URLs,
not the publisher's own address, so those links reach the story via Google.
A publisher's direct RSS feed yields a clean URL and is preferable wherever
one exists — add the outlets that matter most to your coverage area here.
